messages.subject: Re: [dartR] AMOVA analysis
parts:
Hi,

To perform AMOVA using source and statut, you could use the below code:

library(dartRverse)
library(poppr)
gl <- your_genlight
# Converting genlight to genind
geni <- gl2gi(gl)
# Assign pop information to strata
strata(geni) <- data.frame(pop = pop(gl))
# Performing AMOVA
amova_po <- poppr.amova(geni,~pop,nperm = 100)
##AMOVA for statut
strata(geni) <- data.frame(pop = gl@other$ind.metrics$statut)
amova_Statut <- poppr.amova(geni,~pop,nperm = 100)
##AMOVA for origin
strata(geni) <- data.frame(pop = gl@other$ind.metrics$source)
amova_origin <- poppr.amova(geni,~origin,nperm = 100)

Cheers,
Luis
